_how: Event-log digests of the pinned runs (tests/test_sim.gd GOLDEN_RUNS). The Windows tests and the Linux demo (tests/run_sim.gd --golden) must both reproduce them: the same seed gives the same history on every machine. 'memory off' runs are Pilot 1's histories, pinned before memory existed and unchanged by Pilot 2; 'memory on' runs are Pilot 2's, pinned from the Windows run of commit 8d67289; 'crime on' runs are Pilot 3A's (a month, so that thefts happen), pinned from the Windows run of commit d885ed1, which Linux reproduced. Pilot 3A's crime switch is off by default, so the six earlier histories are unchanged by it. Since Pilot 3B, crime on means the whole crime layer; Pilot 3A's three histories are its 'crime on, violence off' runs, relabelled with their digests unchanged, and 'crime on' runs are Pilot 3B's (a month in the tension season, seeds 1 and 3, and in the crisis season, seed 1, long enough for fights, falls and collisions), pinned from the Windows runs of commits a04bd1b to 1949473 (CI runs 38-42), which all gave the same three digests. A deliberate change to the simulation's rules changes them; update them in the same commit and say why.
